source_sql:
-- B-3. 完全外部結合：部門なし社員・社員なし部門の両方を出す
SELECT e.last_name, d.department_name
FROM   employees e
FULL   OUTER JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id
WHERE  e.employee_id IS NULL OR d.department_id IS NULL
